Container.Name: qwen38-flash-next-rocm
Container.Overview: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (125B MoE, 6B active, qwen4exp: Gated DeltaNet + Qwen Sparse Attention + 51B n-gram table) served by llama-server on AMD Strix Halo (gfx1151) via ROCm 10.0. [br]Image is kyuz0's rocm-10.0-qwen-3.8-flash-next toolbox, which tracks drluoto/llama.cpp:strix-halo-flash-next for GPU TOP_K, native MTP speculative decoding, and ngram-mod drafting. ROCm is required for this model: the 47.7 GiB n-gram table exceeds Vulkan's 4 GiB max buffer binding, so Vulkan containers OOM at load. [br]Point MODEL at the first shard of an unsloth/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF build (UD-IQ4_XS fits 128 GB with 262k ctx). Optionally download the MTP sidecar from drluoto/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-MTP-GGUF and the mmproj for vision. [br]Leave GGML_HIP_ENABLE_UNIFIED_MEMORY unset — on unified-memory APUs it lands the whole model in unreclaimable process memory. Thinking mode is on by default; allow generous max_tokens in clients.
Container.Description: Strix Halo-only (gfx1151) llama-server with MTP + ngram-mod speculation, tuned per drluoto's measured run line. Port 8081 avoids colliding with llama-swap on 8080.

Config.Name: HTTP / API
Config.Description: OpenAI-compatible llama-server API (WebUI at root). Internal port 8080.

Config.Name: Models
Config.Description: GGUF files. Shared with the llama-swap template so the same download serves both.

Config.Name: Model GGUF
Config.Description: Path (in-container) to the first shard of the main GGUF; llama.cpp picks up the remaining shards automatically. Download unsloth/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF (UD-IQ4_XS) into the Models share.

Config.Name: MTP draft model
Config.Description: Path to the MTP sidecar GGUF (drluoto/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-MTP-GGUF). Empty disables speculation (17-20 tok/s); set, it composes with ngram-mod for 25-47 tok/s on coding workloads.

Config.Name: mmproj (vision)
Config.Description: Optional path to the mmproj GGUF for vision support. Leave empty to disable multimodal.

Config.Name: Context size
Config.Description: Total KV context. Only the 12 QSA layers grow a KV cache, so 262k costs ~6 GiB. Model + 262k + vision is ~106 GB of 128.

Config.Name: Parallel slots
Config.Description: Server slots. Raise to 3 for agent workloads: with --ctx-checkpoints 8 (hardcoded), sessions keep warm caches via LCP routing, cutting return TTFT from minutes to sub-second.

Config.Name: Disable HIP graphs
Config.Description: Drluoto-verified workaround for HIP graph-capture crashes on gfx1151. Leave at 1.

Config.Name: Extra server args
Config.Description: Appended verbatim to the llama-server command line.
